item.title: The Last Dry Seat

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy.

answer_sheet.Sound, dialogue and text: Silent, with no dialogue, captions or titles.

The woman has a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; the man has a white beard and blue coat.
The opening visibly establishes that the park bench is wet.
The man offers a folded newspaper as a dry place to sit, and the ending shows both characters seated together and smiling.
The film has a live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack.
